Origin story (timeline)

Five chapters, from first hackathon to running India-wide events. Open any moment to read it.

  • May 2026: Bitcoin Pizza Day across India. After two months of planning with PizzaDAO, hosted 40+ in-person Bitcoin Pizza Day events across India, all on the same day. Link
  • 2026: Content creation era. Made creating content a consistent habit.
  • Oct 2025: PizzaDAO in Delhi. Helped PizzaDAO execute its Delhi community event. Link
  • Sep 2025: First ETHGlobal: New Delhi. Attended my first ETHGlobal event in New Delhi and co-hosted a community party with the EVVM team. It was a huge success. Link
  • 2025: Shipping for clients. Shipped two production frontends for paying clients, including SuiSips, using AI-assisted workflows with v0, Cursor and Claude. Link
  • Apr 2025: Back to Web3Panjab. Stepped away from Tezos India to focus on Web3Panjab, making it sustainable through paid events and freelance work.
  • Nov 2024: Speaker at GDG DevFest New Delhi. Once an attendee, then a community partner, now a speaker: at GDG New Delhi's DevFest I showed how to deploy EVM-compatible code on Tezos using Etherlink. Link
  • Aug 2024: WebX Asia, Tokyo. Attended WebX 2024 in Tokyo, one of Asia's largest Web3 conferences. Link
  • Aug 2024: ETHTokyo. Made it to ETHTokyo and joined the builder community in Japan. Link
  • Aug 2024: First solo international trip: Japan. Travelled to Japan on my own for the first time, a trip built around ETHTokyo and WebX.
  • May 2024: Bitcoin Pizza Day with PizzaDAO. Hosted a Bitcoin Pizza Day party with PizzaDAO, supported by Flipster, Intract and Bitget India. Link
  • Apr 2024: Workshop & panel at Chandigarh University. Ran a hands-on workshop and a panel discussion on blockchain and dApps with the Tezos DevRel team and Antier. Link
  • Jan 2024: SmartPy workshops, online. Ran interactive online sessions on building on Tezos with SmartPy. Link
  • Jan 2024: SmartPy workshop at IGDTUW, Delhi. My first offline session of 2024: developing on Tezos with SmartPy, hosted with the IGDTUW team. Link
  • Jan 2024: Developer advocate for Etherlink. Took on developer advocacy for Etherlink, the EVM Layer 2 on Tezos, alongside my Tezos India role.
  • Dec 2023: ETHIndia 2023. Back at ETHIndia in Bengaluru for its 2023 edition. Link
  • Dec 2023: TezDay in Bengaluru. Hosted a Tezos India TezDay meetup in Whitefield, Bengaluru, during ETHIndia week. Link
  • Sep 2023: Blockchain orientation at MSIT. Led an in-person orientation session on blockchain for students at Maharaja Surajmal Institute of Technology, New Delhi. Link
  • 2023: Speaker at Web3Conf India. Spoke at the second edition of Web3Conf India on Metaverse-as-a-Service and how it works with blockchain.
  • 2023: Full-time DevRel Lead. Moved into a full-time role as Developer Relations Lead at Tezos India.
  • Dec 2022: First Web3 conference: ETHIndia. Attended my first Web3 conference, which was also my first trip for one. I learned a lot.
  • Oct 2022: Joined Tezos India. Joined Tezos India as a Developer Relations intern, focused on onboarding developers to the Tezos blockchain in India.
  • 1 Oct 2022: First offline Web3Panjab session. Organised two meetups in Chandigarh on the same day and gave my first in-person talk: an introduction to Web3 and blockchain. Link
  • Sep 2022: A month of firsts. Attended the Solana Hacker House in New Delhi, received a Linux Foundation travel scholarship to Open Source Summit in Dublin, and became the CoinDCX local chapter lead for Chandigarh. Link
  • 16 Jul 2022: The Web3Panjab journey begins. Launched Web3Panjab in Chandigarh to promote Web3 and open source and to onboard new people across Punjab and North India. It has hosted many events since.
  • 2022: The Web3 leap. Began the year as a research trainee at DRDO, then founded Web3Panjab and joined Tezos India in Developer Relations. I never looked back.
  • 2021: Technical writing & GirlScript Winter of Code. Worked as a technical content writer at The SidePath and contributed to GirlScript Winter of Code.
  • 2020: Open-source season. Top 25 contributor at Contributor's Hack (Student Code-In), working on YouthIcon ML datasets for Asian languages. Also a student trainee at Quantel.
  • 2020: DSC GTBIT & CPPIndia. Outreach and logistics head at DSC GTBIT, competitive programming mentor, and session moderator for CPPIndia.
  • 2019: NASA Space Apps. Won 1st prize at the NASA Space Apps Challenge prequalifier and finished in the Top 10 at the India North-region qualifiers.
  • 2019: First hackathon win. Won 3rd prize at HackGTBIT and was a Top-5 Campus Ambassador for ESYA '19 at IIIT Delhi. The hackathon bug bit hard.

Posts on X

  • Apr 8, 2025: Before uploading the third part of my video series on building with Sui from a Solidity dev's perspective, I made a starter pack for people to explore and join the Sui ecosystem.
  • May 3, 2025: Attention is the most valuable on-chain asset. Not liquidity. Not memes. Not clout. What if you could mine a token just by paying attention?
  • Jan 30, 2025: Procrastinated a lot last year on one of my yearly goals: tech content creation. Finally solved it. I learned about Move, Sui and Aptos and shared it in this video.
  • Apr 11, 2025: While bridging USDC from Polygon to Sui, I got stuck. Bridge successful, but couldn't claim. Why? Needed SUI for gas. That rabbit hole led me to…
  • May 13, 2025: What is Bluefin? A decentralized exchange on Sui offering low-latency trading, perps, lending and staking. A thread.
  • Feb 19, 2025: New video: diving into Sui Move and breaking down Solidity code to see how things change when coding in Move. Episode 2 of the series.
  • May 23, 2026: Two months of planning with PizzaDAO, and it was so much fun hosting the Global Bitcoin Pizza Party across India this year.
  • Sep 28, 2025: Hosted one of the best parties during ETHGlobal New Delhi, with friends from RollAMate, CoW Swap, Camp Network and PizzaDAO.
  • Oct 18, 2025: PizzaDAO thanks @simarpreet_019 for helping execute its Delhi event.
  • Sep 20, 2022: An exciting month: Solana Hacker House New Delhi, a Linux Foundation travel scholarship to Open Source Summit Dublin, and becoming CoinDCX's local chapter lead in Chandigarh.
